map.根据红细胞平均体积（MCV）与红细胞分布宽度（RDW）对贫血进行初步形态学分类（: A preliminary morphological classification of anemia from the mean corpuscular volume (MCV) and the red cell distribution width (RDW), using the Bessman classification.
map.📖 查看「贫血 MCV/RDW 分类 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Anemia MCV/RDW Classification Usage Guide"
map.Bessman 分类按 MCV 与 RDW 组合：MCV 小于 80 fL 为小: The Bessman classification combines MCV and RDW: MCV below 80 fL is microcytic, 80 to 100 fL normocytic and above 100 fL macrocytic, while an RDW above 14.5% indicates anisocytosis. Microcytic with a raised RDW is usually iron deficiency anemia, normocytic with a raised RDW suggests a mixed anemia, and macrocytic with a raised RDW suggests folate or vitamin B12 deficiency.
map.已知 MCV 与 RDW，做 Bessman 形态学初步分类（小细胞/正细胞/大: Given MCV and RDW, make the preliminary Bessman morphological classification (microcytic, normocytic or macrocytic combined with homogeneous or heterogeneous).
map.用 RDW 是否 >15% 判断红细胞大小离散度，定位缺铁或地中海贫血: Use whether RDW exceeds 15% to judge the spread of red cell size and to locate iron deficiency or thalassemia.
map.作为贫血第一步筛查，再针对性查铁代谢/血红蛋白电泳/叶酸B12: Use it as the first screening step for anemia, then target iron studies, haemoglobin electrophoresis, or folate and B12.
map.Bessman 分类法：先按 MCV 分小细胞性(<80)、正细胞性(80–10: Bessman classification: first split by MCV into microcytic (below 80), normocytic (80–100) and macrocytic (above 100); then by RDW (reference 15% or less) into homogeneous or heterogeneous, giving six combinations: microcytic heterogeneous (typical iron deficiency), microcytic homogeneous (thalassemia or chronic disease), normocytic heterogeneous (early iron deficiency or mixed), normocytic homogeneous (acute blood loss or renal anemia), macrocytic heterogeneous (megaloblastic) and macrocytic homogeneous (alcohol, liver disease or drugs).
map.例（MCV=70 fL、RDW=18%）：MCV<80 → 小细胞性；RDW=1: Example (MCV = 70 fL, RDW = 18%): MCV below 80 means microcytic and RDW of 18%, above 15%, means heterogeneous, so this is microcytic heterogeneous anemia, most often caused by iron deficiency, which can be distinguished from the microcytic homogeneous pattern of thalassemia.
map.MCV/RDW 能区分缺铁和地贫吗？: Can MCV and RDW distinguish iron deficiency from thalassemia?
map.有提示价值：缺铁多为小细胞+RDW 升高（不均一），典型地贫多为小细胞+RDW: They give a hint: iron deficiency is usually microcytic with a raised RDW (heterogeneous), while typical thalassemia is microcytic with a normal RDW (homogeneous). The overlap is considerable though, and the diagnosis rests on serum iron and ferritin together with haemoglobin electrophoresis or genetic testing.
map.RDW 参考值为什么是 ≤15%？: Why is the RDW reference 15% or less?
map.RDW 反映红细胞体积: RDW reflects the spread of red cell volumes,
map.，多数实验室参考上限约 14–15%；不同仪器/人群略有差异，判读以本实验室参考: and most laboratories set the upper reference limit at about 14–15%; instruments and populations differ slightly, so interpret it against your own laboratory reference interval. This tool is for morphological screening only.
